label: Compile and Run C++ (GCC)
command: if [ -z "$ZED_FILE" ]; then echo 'Error: Please open and focus a .cpp file first!'; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/bin" && /opt/homebrew/opt/gcc/bin/g++-15 -std=c++23 -O2 -Wall -Wextra "$ZED_FILE" -o "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/bin/$ZED_STEM" && "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/bin/$ZED_STEM"
